# Convert Image - Finder

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Convert an image to another format. This is the same as the convertImage action, however it uses a different UI for macOS

## Syntax

~~~~text
convertImageFinder(image: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
convertImageFinder(image: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
